bullets.text: Active Exploitation of SolarWinds - **Microsoft Defender** reveals ongoing attacks exploiting **SolarWinds Web Help Desk** vulnerabilities.
Safer Online Learning - **Microsoft Edge for Business** enhances security for K–12 online learning environments.
AI Agents on the Rise - Over 80% of **Fortune 500** companies utilize active AI agents, emphasizing governance and security.
AI Recommendation Poisoning - New trend identified where companies manipulate AI recommendations for biased outcomes.
Windows 11 Insider Preview Updates - New builds released for **Windows 11** with features and improvements.
Strengthening Windows Security - New initiatives focus on user transparency and consent to enhance security.
Detecting Backdoored Models - **Microsoft** releases research on identifying backdoors in language models.
Operation Winter SHIELD - **Microsoft** supports a cybersecurity initiative addressing the implementation gap in security.
